Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 18
, Reason for Mistake: Incorrectly identified the pitcher with uniform number 18 as Sachiya Yamasaki, who was not on the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters in July 2023 (he was with Orix). This conflated team rosters and led to a wrong “before” pitcher; the claim was made without verifying the Fighters’ official roster for that date.
